newsitem.title: UK: UK industrial production rises 1.2 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: UK industrial production rises 1.2 pct in April.

text.p: British industrial production rose 1.2 percent in April, after a 0.2 percent fall in March, official figures showed on Monday.

Prices at the factory gate, a key indicator of inflationary pressures, rose 0.1 percent in May to show a 1.0 percent change on May 1996. The price figures were in line with analysts' expectations while output data showed more robust growth than expected.
Analysts said the output figures showed the economy was still growing strongly.
"Certainly on the manufacturing side it indicates that the strength of sterling has yet to have an impact on manufacturing production," said Philip Shaw, economist at Union Plc.
"It really vindicates the Bank of England's decision last Friday to raise interest rates by 25 basis points."
Government bonds dipped after the figures while sterling firmed slightly. Interest rates have been raised twice since the Labour government came to power on May 1 and now stand at 6.5 percent.
